items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: Eddie Mallory had the band. He had a great band. That's one of the first times I saw Don Byas.

ctx.x: -- Eddie Mallory had the band. He had a great band. That's one of the first times I saw Don Byas. Of course, Don Byas had played with Bennie Carter before that, you see. But that's when I first heard him, and to this day I don't know anybody, to me, that is an all-around tenor player that was his equal. He had everything there was to have from a melodic standpoint. He could play fast as anybody that you ever heard. If you remember, he and Dizzy used to play them real fast unison things in 52nd Street in the bop…
